name: MAX31820 1-Wire ambient temperature sensor
description: Maxim/Analog Devices 1-Wire ambient temperature sensor, -55 to +125 °C (±0.5 °C from +10 to +45 °C, ±2 °C over the full range), 9-12 bit resolution (0.0625 °C at the default 12 bits, 750 ms conversion), unique 64-bit ROM code with family code 28h, software compatible with the DS18B20 and DS1822. Runs on 3.0-3.7 V only (not 5 V). Sold as: MAX31820MCR+ bare chip in a 3-pin TO-92 through-hole package (flat face towards you, legs down: GND, DQ, VDD), needing an external 4.7 kΩ pull-up from DQ to VDD.
eli5: A small thermometer chip that sends the room temperature as a number down a single wire; several can share the same wire.

pins.name: GND
pins.description: Ground (TO-92 pin 1, left with the flat face towards you)

pins.name: DQ
pins.description: 1-Wire data in/out, open-drain (TO-92 pin 2, middle); needs a 4.7 kΩ pull-up to VDD

pins.name: VDD
pins.description: Supply, 3.0-3.7 V (TO-92 pin 3, right). Feed it from 3.3 V, never 5 V

buildNotes: Pin order with the flat face towards you, legs down: left = GND, middle = DQ, right = VDD (same as a DS18B20). Wired backwards it gets hot fast: unplug it at once.
Supply is 3.0-3.7 V: power VDD from the board's 3.3 V pin, not 5 V (unlike the DS18B20).
Fit a 4.7 kΩ pull-up from DQ to VDD (3.3 V); the bare chip has none.
Send Convert T (44h), then wait at least 750 ms (12-bit) before Read Scratchpad (BEh); MicroPython's ds18x20 module does the commands and the CRC check (family 28h), your code does the wait.

Temperature = signed 16-bit register x 0.0625 °C at 12 bits (0191h = +25.0625 °C, FF5Eh = -10.125 °C). A reading of exactly 85 °C is the power-on value: the conversion did not finish or the sensor lost power.
For true air temperature keep it away from warm parts and copper, and in any air flow; the TO-92 legs carry board heat.
Use VDD (local power), not parasite power: parasite mode needs VDD grounded and a strong pull-up within 10 µs of every Convert T.

example.code:
import machine, onewire, ds18x20, time

ds = ds18x20.DS18X20(onewire.OneWire(machine.Pin({DQ})))
roms = ds.scan()
print('found', len(roms))
while True:
    ds.convert_temp()
    time.sleep_ms(750)  # 12-bit conversion: up to 750 ms
    print('T=%.2fC' % ds.read_temp(roms[0]))
    time.sleep(1)

test.title: Reports the temperature set on the slider
